1879089819.name: Fly True
1879089819.desc: A potent ranged attack that causes devastating damage on critical hit.  It will never miss against on-level creatures.

1879094939.name: Call of the Second Age
1879094939.desc: Deals a burst of AoE Light damage to nearby foes.\n\nBoosts movement speed of nearby allies.

procEffects.description: Damaging skills have a  *  chance to make your next healing skill crit.
Scoring a Critical Hit increases Outgoing Healing by 10% for 10s. You cannot gain this effect more than once every 25s.

1879097883.name: Vital Target
1879097883.desc: Your knowledge of the enemy is so great that you can target vital organs with great efficacy.

1879115291.name: 1H Weapon Attack
1879115291.desc: Auto-attack when wielding only a single one-handed weapon.

1879134363.name: Shield and Fist
1879134363.desc: Mastery over the Shield: Allows Warden to perform Shield Gambits quickly.

1879136795.name: Keen Eye
1879136795.desc: You firmly plant your feet and take aim.\n\n<rgb=#00ff00>Each ranged attacked improves your damage, attack speed and inductions.  These effects are dispelled upon exiting the stance.</rgb>

1879160859.name: Same as above, except no Min Distance requirement

1879209883.name: Steed of the Burglar
1879209883.desc: A mount carrying all the trappings that are used and needed by the burglar.

1879215003.name: Improved Staff Sweep
1879215003.desc: Sweeps the staff to strike surrounding foes.\n\nFor each enemy hit, you receive a buff to Crit Chance for your next Fire Skill.

1879232411.name: Piercing Toss
1879232411.desc: A piercing attack which deals Light Damage over time.

procEffects.description: When enemies Block, Parry, or Evade your attacks, you have a chance of quickly following up from another angle, dealing:

1879239579.name: Establishing Shot
1879239579.desc: You release a projectile at your target without regard for aim. Though inaccurate, each successful strike with this skill will increase your chance to hit and your chance to score a critical strike against a target. You can gain these benefits up to 5 times. A succssful critical hit will dispel all stacked effects.

procEffects.description: DNT - Attacks have a chance to reduce your enemies Critical Defence for  short duration
On Every Harmful Skill, \n On Critical Hit:
On every Harmful skill,\n50% chance on Critical Hit:
On every Harmful skill,\nOn Critical Hit:

1879241627.name: Discipline: Red Dawn
1879241627.desc:
<rgb=#66fff>Mounted Discipline</rgb>

Mounted Disciplines are used to alter the attitude and tactics used by your War-steed in Mounted Combat.

<rgb=#66ffff>Red Dawn</rgb>

The Red Dawn Discipline focuses your attention on the dissonant harmonies of the world. When applied correctly this dissonance can reduce your enemy's ability to remain on the field of battle.

1879244571.name: Ranged Persevere
1879244571.desc: A shield strike, which heals you over time and increases incoming healing.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>Using will restore this skill to Battle Memory.</rgb>

conditionalEffects.description: Shield Gambits each restore 2.5% of your max health and reduce the cooldown of Desperate Combat by 2 seconds.
Two-length gambits will tier up an effect that improves the damage of your next Spear of Fate.\nAt tier 3, Spear of Fate removes your Mastery cooldowns for a brief moment.

1879245851.name: War-steed: Medium
1879245851.desc: The Rouncey is a moderately armoured War-steed. The Rouncey provides balance and stability without sacrificing or favouring survivability or manoeuvrability.

1879260059.name: Heart Seeker
1879260059.desc: A shot that cannot be missed, parried, evaded, or blocked.

1879269659.name: Trickster
1879269659.desc: A Trickster is so adept at toying with their enemies that they are practically invisible, and their allies take heart at the sight.

1879270299.name: In the Fray - Stance
1879270299.desc: Adjusts stance to deal with enemies in melee combat.\n(Only one Stance may be active at a time.)

1879311259.name: Hearten
1879311259.desc: Words of encouragement help your allies through dark times.

conditionalEffects.description: \nHearten refunds its Wrath cost upon use.

1879318299.name: Nature's Bond
1879318299.desc: Re-directs a portion of the healing you receive to your friend.

1879326491.name: Red Beetle
1879326491.desc: Summons a beetle to keep you company.

1879338651.name: Steed of the Gloaming Autumn
1879338651.desc: A pony from the Fall Festival.

1879342107.name: Return to Haerondir
1879342107.desc: Thanks to your friendship with the Host of the West, you're able to quickly return to Haerondir. This skill is easily interrupted.

1879366939.name: Elk of Felegoth's Night
1879366939.desc: A mighty Lasgalen elk, garbed to blend in with the night.

1879391387.name: Call to Arms: Herald of Hope (Elvish Maid-at-arms)
1879391387.desc: You enlist a Herald to carry your Banner of Hope into battle. This banner increases the mitigations of those around it.

1879408667.name: Blackroot Steed
1879408667.desc: A proud steed of the Blackroot.

1879457563.name: The Way of the Spear
1879457563.desc:
Wardens know that the surest path to victory is relying on the basics.

This skill changes to match the type of the last gambit used.

The Way of the Spear will consume all your Advanced Technique to improve your initial hit damage for a brief time.

1879466267.name: Sail to Pelargir
1879466267.desc: Navigate to Pelargir in King's Gondor with nearby fellows.

1879467291.name: Rummage: Button
1879467291.desc: An old button that reminds you of home.

1879485339.name: Spotted Hamster
1879485339.desc: Summons an adorable hamster to keep you company.

1879488027.name: Friend of Large Hunters (Savannah Hunter Juvenile)
1879488027.desc: Summons a big cat companion.\n\nThe cat is capable of attacking multiple foes at once.

1879523995.name: The Silver Arrow
1879523995.desc: Loose an arrow filled with the light of the moon, damaging enemies in front of you and all along the arrow's path.

conditionalEffects.description: Ranged Focus Spenders increase your Ranged Damage until your next Ranged Focus Builder.

1879525275.name: Quintessential Fawn
1879525275.desc: Summons an adorable fawn to accompany you on your travels.
